tool_args.rationale: The target forecast horizon is 21.1, far beyond the observed H≤0.48 pilot. The documented dual-horizon mechanism predicts a sign reversal in this long-horizon range, making a slow-horizon observation the discriminating, necessary probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations show positive gain only; they do not constrain the slow adaptation amplitude/time scale or establish the predicted reversal at H≈15–25.
That batch is aimed at identifying coupled memory ODEs and is unnecessary for the leading dual-horizon candidate.
It is explicitly irrelevant and costly.
